# API-Football Pro Plan: How to Use 7,500 Calls/Day
*Generated by 9-agent research pipeline — 2026-06-10*

## Current Usage Baseline

| Source | Calls/Day |
|---|---|
| Sunday collect: fixtures list (11 leagues) | ~23 amortized |
| Sunday collect: `/fixtures/players` (permanent cache) | ~23 amortized |
| Predict-time fixture lookups (5 runs/day) | ~30 |
| OddsAPI scores (live scanner, match days) | ~25 |
| Misc | ~3 |
| **Total today** | **~104/day (1.4% of quota)** |

**Headroom: ~7,396 calls/day unused. API plan is not a constraint on any decision.**

---

## Tier 1 — Implement First (highest ROI per call)

### 1. Edge Threshold Recalibration + Dead Feature Removal — 0 API calls
- **Already done** (2026-06-10)
- Dropped 7 dead features, raised thresholds, added 19% ceiling
- Expected: +3-5% ROI, +0.5-1% AUC

### 2. `GET /standings` — Table Position + Form Features
- **Endpoint:** `GET /standings?league={id}&season={year}`
- **Calls/day:** 11 (one per league, 24-hour TTL cache)
- **Features:** `home_table_position`, `away_table_position` (normalized), `home_gd_per_game`, `away_gd_per_game`, `home_home_win_rate`, `away_away_win_rate`, `home_form_pts`, `away_form_pts`
- **Impact:** Model currently has zero season-scale quality signal — all features are rolling-5-game proxies. Table position is orthogonal. Also fixes hardcoded 1.3/4.5 fallbacks in player props for new opponents. High value for WC2026 group tables.
- **Estimated:** +0.006–0.012 AUC
- **Effort:** LOW

### 3. `GET /fixtures/statistics` — Fix NaN-Polluted Shots/Corners/Fouls
- **Endpoint:** `GET /fixtures/statistics?fixture={id}`
- **Calls/day:** ~1,100 first Sunday, then ~13/day amortized (permanent cache)
- **Features repaired:** `home_shots_last5`, `away_shots_last5`, `home_sot_last5`, `away_sot_last5`, `home_corners_pg_roll`, `away_corners_pg_roll`, `home_fouls_pg_roll`, `away_fouls_pg_roll`
- **New features:** `home_possession_last5`, `away_possession_last5`, `home_offsides_last5`, `away_offsides_last5`
- **Impact:** These 5 degraded features account for **33.06% of GBM importance mass** — more than the top-4 strength metrics combined. All currently imputed with fillna(0.35). Bundesliga 2 (worst league at 3.5% ROI) has sparsest CSV coverage and benefits most.
- **Estimated:** +0.008–0.015 AUC
- **Effort:** LOW (mirrors existing `_fetch_fixture_player_stats()` structure)

### 4. `GET /fixtures?live=all` — Replace Fabricated Game Clock
- **Endpoint:** `GET /fixtures?live=all`
- **Calls/day:** ~30 on match days (replaces OddsAPI score calls — net neutral)
- **Impact:** Live scanner fabricates game clock with wall-clock arithmetic (line 221). HT signals fire on fiction. Real `fixture.status.elapsed` and `fixture.status.short` (1H/HT/2H) makes every live signal correct. Also removes OddsAPI dependency for live scores — redundancy against quota issues like May 2026 shutdown.
- **Effort:** MED

---

## Tier 2 — Implement Next

### 5. `GET /injuries` — Pre-Match Injury/Suspension Filter
- **Endpoint:** `GET /injuries?league={id}&season={year}&fixture={fixture_id}`
- **Calls/day:** ~11–22 on match days, zero otherwise
- **Features:** `home_injured_attackers`, `away_injured_attackers`, `home_injury_severity_score`, `away_injury_severity_score`
- **Gate:** Cap tier at MARKSMAN when 2+ attacking absences
- **Impact:** System is completely blind to team news. Market reprices heavily on injuries — most invalidated edges come from this. Three agents independently flagged as highest priority.
- **Estimated:** +0.004–0.009 AUC + reduced high-variance losses
- **Effort:** MED

### 6. `GET /odds` — Multi-Book Sharp Price Replaces Single OddsAPI Line
- **Endpoint:** `GET /odds?fixture={id}&bookmaker=6` (Bet365 / Pinnacle)
- **Calls/day:** ~15–40 on match days
- **Impact:** Current edge calc compares model vs single OddsAPI price (may be soft book). A +7% edge vs OddsAPI's 1.95 may be only +3% vs Pinnacle's 1.85. Tightens tier assignments system-wide without touching the model.
- **Effort:** LOW

### 7. `GET /fixtures/statistics` in Live Scanner — Shot-Count Lambda Adjustment
- **Calls/day:** ~3–10 on match days (per live fixture, separate from Sunday collect)
- **Impact:** Game with 12 shots and 0 goals at 60 min ≠ game with 2 shots and 0 goals. SLEEPING_GAME/UNDER false positives reduced by shot confirmation gate.
- **Effort:** MED (requires Tier 1 item 4 first)

### 8. `GET /fixtures?h2h={team_A}-{team_B}` — Head-to-Head Features
- **Calls/day:** ~10–20 on match days (30-day TTL cache)
- **Features:** `h2h_avg_goals`, `h2h_over25_rate`, `h2h_home_win_rate`, `h2h_btts_rate`
- **Impact:** Most predictive in derbies/rivalry fixtures. Directly targets the O/U target variable. June 10 analysis estimated +1–2% AUC. Two agents independently proposed.
- **Effort:** MED

---

## Tier 3 — Future / Nice-to-Have

### 9. `GET /predictions` — API-Football Meta-Model as Drift Confirmation
- 15–40 calls/day. Secondary confirmation signal. Value uncertain vs `/odds`. Implement after `/odds` validated.

### 10. `GET /fixtures/events` — Goal Recency Suppression in Live Scanner
- 1–5 calls/day (only on triggered live signals). Prevents UNDER signals immediately after a goal in a high-tempo game. Promote to Tier 2 once item 4 is live.

### 11. `starter_rate` Feature from Lineups (Zero new API calls)
- Data already fetched in `api_football.py` but `games.substitute` field not parsed.
- Add to `_parse_fixture_player()` + `PLAYER_FEATURE_COLS`. Requires player props retrain.

## What NOT to Do

- **No Shin de-vig yet** — current AUC 0.54 is too low to benefit from precise odds comparison. Fix data quality first (Tier 1 items 2-3), retrain, then revisit.
- **Remove newformat model entirely** — it uses only 2 features and produces impossible 125% backtest ROI. Using as tiebreaker pollutes the ensemble. Remove in next planned retrain.
- **No /fixtures/events for all historical fixtures** — same improvement achievable more cheaply via /fixtures/statistics. Revisit after statistics feed is live.
- **No substitution timing feature** — weak novel signal, no validation basis, high engineering cost.
- **Don't apply seasonal stake reduction (Finding 4) yet** — the Feb/May ROI dip is largely explained by the 4-12% edge bets being eliminated by threshold raise. Validate after P0 changes are live.
